openingRequest.zh-CN: 请帮助我们设计一个会调用业务系统工具的客服代理，自动处理大部分请求，并在敏感操作上保留人工。
openingRequest.en-US: Please help us design a customer-support agent that calls business-system tools, handles most requests automatically, and keeps humans on sensitive actions.

visibleContext.zh-CN: 我们是一家软件即服务公司，运营着一个客户支持中心。管理层希望上线会调用 CRM、订单和退款/物流接口的工具型客服代理，而不是给规则引擎套一层聊天皮肤。目标是自动处理大部分请求，同时在敏感动作上保留人工。
visibleContext.en-US: We are a software-as-a-service company running a customer support center. Leadership wants a tool-calling agent (CRM, order, and refund/shipping APIs), not a rules engine with a chat skin. The agent should handle most requests automatically while keeping humans on sensitive actions.

visibleConstraints.zh-CN: 付款、退款和账户变更动作必须先经人工确认（HITL）才能执行
visibleConstraints.en-US: Payment, refund, and account-change actions require a human (HITL) before they may run

visibleConstraints.zh-CN: 客户工单数据不得发送到境外的第三方大模型
visibleConstraints.en-US: Customer ticket data must not be sent to offshore third-party LLMs
The agent must not fabricate policy

visibleConstraints.zh-CN: 允许调用的工具是 CRM、订单和退款接口；代理不得把超时的退款调用静默重试并当成成功
visibleConstraints.en-US: Allowed tools are the CRM, order, and refund APIs; the agent must not silently retry a timed-out refund call as success

deliverables.zh-CN: 客服代理方案设计文档
工具调用代理与 FAQ 机器人的权衡分析
deliverables.en-US: Tool-calling agent vs. FAQ-bot trade-off analysis

deliverables.zh-CN: 升级通道与人工确认（HITL）流程
质量、延迟与成本的度量体系
deliverables.en-US: Quality, latency, and cost measurement framework

learnerRules.zh-CN: 你只有12个问题预算来了解这家客户的客服代理现状
learnerRules.en-US: You have a budget of 12 questions to understand this customer's support-agent situation

learnerRules.zh-CN: 每个问题必须指定由哪位干系人回答
learnerRules.en-US: Each question must specify which stakeholder will answer

learnerRules.zh-CN: 你需要在DISCOVERY阶段逐步发现隐藏的业务事实
learnerRules.en-US: You need to gradually discover hidden business facts in the DISCOVERY phase

learnerRules.zh-CN: 在PITCH阶段你需要向管理层展示方案并争取批准
learnerRules.en-US: In the PITCH phase, you must present the solution to management for approval
